syllabus: Unit 6 has 〜て、〜, 〜てください, 〜ないでください, 〜てもいいです, 〜てはいけません, 〜なくてもいいです, 〜ている (now), 〜ている (state), 〜に行く and 〜つもりです: a fair N5 set in a sensible order, given that 〜なくてもいいです and 〜つもり sit on the N5/N4 line and ない- and plain forms appear as set shapes before unit 7 teaches them?

n5u06d1.d1: Many wrong options in this unit are made-up forms that are not words (読みて, 書いで, 飲んて, 来ないくても, すわるも, 安んで, でるくち). Acceptable as distractors?
n5u06d1.d5: Stars d5, d6 and e3 seem easy. Fine for the first te-form day?
n5u06d1.k: Test-sheet scene: 後ろ shows 後 read うし, and 四十分 is よんじゅっぷん. Day 1 also uses しゅくだい, そうじ, そば, ゆっくり, おりる, かお, あらう, プリント. Fair?
n5u06d2.d1: Answer 入らないで (ここは出口です). 入ってください is grammatical and wrong only on meaning. Clearly wrong?
n5u06d2.d4: Answer すみません、ちょっと… (きょうはさむいですから). ええ、どうぞ and はい、あけましょう fail only on meaning. Clearly wrong?
n5u06d2.e3: Same pattern as star d6 (〜てもいいですか). Too close?
n5u06d2.k: Park sign: are 午前 and 午後 natural there? Day 2 also uses すわる, じしょ, まどをあける, でんわをかける, おかし, ごみをもってかえる, さんぽ, おしらせ, こうえん. Fair?
n5u06d3.p2: The ない table has no はしらない or とらない, though c1 and the listening use them. Add them?
n5u06d3.d1: Answer 食べてはいけません. いいえ、食べなくてもいいです is wrong only as a non-answer to a permission question. Clearly wrong?
n5u06d3.d3: Rewritten after the check (options now in kana: こなくてもいいです). Please read once.
n5u06d3.d4: The blank cuts the verb (読（　　）, answer まなくてもいいです). Clear enough for N5?
n5u06d3.d5: Stars d5 and e3 seem easy. Fine?
n5u06d3.e1: Answer いけません. Please confirm 入ってはしません is clearly wrong.
n5u06d3.k: Pool scene. Day 3 also uses じゅぎょう, あぶない, ぼうしをとる, たばこをすう, シャワーをあびる, おかし. All fair N5 words?
n5u06d3.r1: Quick response. いいえ、とらなくてもいいです fails only as a non-answer to permission; はい、とりました may be too easy. Both fine?
n5u06d4.p1: The watch note marks 父は今、新聞を読みます wrong, but it is grammatical as 'is about to read'. Fair as the ✕ example?
n5u06d4.p2: The two points are labelled 〜ています（いま） and 〜ています（じょうたい）. Clear labels?
n5u06d4.d5: Star item. The tiles split 人 and と (会社の人と). Fair?
n5u06d4.d6: Star item. Please confirm 人のあの名前をしりません is clearly wrong.
n5u06d4.e3: Star item. 白い can only go with シャツ (くろいめがねをかけています). Is that clear to a native?
n5u06d4.k: Office-board scene. Day 4 also writes 今日 and 三年前 in kanji. Fine for N5?
n5u06d4.k1: Answer でんわ. The wrong reading でんか is a real word. Clearly wrong?
n5u06d5.d5: Stars d5, d6 and e3 seem easy. Fine?
n5u06d5.k: Calendar scene. Day 5 also uses かえす, 本や, しゃしんをとる, あそびに来ます, 出かけませんか, こうえん, テスト. All fair N5 words?
n5u06d6.c1: Answer 来なくてもいいです. 来てはいけません is wrong on logic only (there are many pens). Clearly wrong?
n5u06d6.d2: Answer 買いに／います (母は今、店へパンを買いに行っています). 行っています (gone and there now) is borderline N5, with two blanks. Fair?
n5u06d6.d4: Answer あらって. あらいます and あらっています are wrong only because the sentence goes on. Clearly wrong?
n5u06d6.d5: Star item. No comma after いけませんが (…いけませんが水を飲んでもいいです). Fine?
n5u06d6.e3: Close to the day 2 star d5 (大きいこえで話さないでください). Too similar?
n5u06d6.k: School-notice scene. Day 6 also uses 中国, 来年, としょしつ, ばんごう, いもうと, こたえ. All fair for N5?
n5u06d6.k1: Answer 毎日. The wrong option 毎月 is a real word. Clearly wrong for まいにち?
n5u06t.6: Uses ろうか. A fair N5 word?
n5u06t.8: Answer 母のお母さん. The explanation names the aunts おばさん. Fine for N5?
n5u06t.14: Answer まっています. Is まちます clearly wrong after 今何をしていますか?
n5u06t.16: 〜てください is tested only in this star item. Enough?
n5u06t.17: Star item (ギターをひいている人). Is noun-modifying ている fair at N5?
n5u06t.18: Star item. べんきょうし (a stem) stands as its own tile. Fair?
n5u06t.21: Answer 本を四さつかります. 月よう日に本をかります is wrong only because the library is closed on Mondays. Clear enough?
sound.u6d4.電話: Synthetic voice: 電話 is heard as では or でも. Please listen (N5 unit 6, day 4, the office board, tap 電話).
